chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from 'Ali ibn Sayf, from Hassan ibn Mihran, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about making up the supererogatory prayers. He said: Between sunrise and its setting.

key_terms.طُلُوعِ: the rising, here referring to sunrise
key_terms.غُرُوبِهَا: its setting, here referring to the setting of the sun
key_terms.قَضَاءِ: making up an act of worship after its appointed time has passed

ai.seo_question: When can missed nawafil prayers be made up according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the time for making up missed nawafil prayers. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that their qada' may be performed between sunrise and sunset.
